attendance_locations_work_hours.name: attendance_locations_work_hours
attendance_locations_work_hours.value: ("attendance_locations"."work_start_minute" is null and "attendance_locations"."work_end_minute" is null) or ("attendance_locations"."work_start_minute" between 0 and 1439 and "attendance_locations"."work_end_minute" between 1 and 1439 and "attendance_locations"."work_start_minute" < "attendance_locations"."work_end_minute")

company_settings_work_hours.name: company_settings_work_hours
company_settings_work_hours.value: "company_settings"."work_start_minute" between 0 and 1439 and "company_settings"."work_end_minute" between 1 and 1439 and "company_settings"."work_start_minute" < "company_settings"."work_end_minute"

subscriptions_kind_check.name: subscriptions_kind_check
subscriptions_kind_check.value: ("subscriptions"."kind" = 'PLAN' AND "subscriptions"."months" IN (1, 6, 12)) OR ("subscriptions"."kind" IN ('TOPUP', 'ADDON') AND "subscriptions"."months" IS NULL)
